summary_1line: Arjuna rallies Virata’s son, charges Bhishma’s division, defeats several Kaurava warriors, and devastates the Kuru army with overwhelming archery.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands on his chariot drawing the Gandiva while arrows pour from him like lightning into the massed Kuru army.
Arjuna’s golden arrow slices Bhishma’s tall banner from its pole, the standard tumbling to the battlefield.
The battlefield lies strewn with severed heads, broken chariots, and fallen elephants as Arjuna’s chariot wheels through the chaos.
